key.name: control-port
key.summary: Port of the MailCraft control channel
key.description: MailCraft must be started with --control and this port.

key.name: endpoint
key.summary: Address of the language model endpoint
key.description: For Ollama the server address, for OpenAI-compatible endpoints the base address including /v1.

key.name: threshold
key.description: Mail with a spam value at or above this threshold is moved to the junk folder.

key.name: interval-minutes
key.summary: Minutes between checks of the inbox

key.name: max-chars
key.summary: Longest mail text sent to the model, in characters

key.name: skip-sent
key.summary: Never check senders you have written to

key.name: skip-contacts
key.summary: Never check senders in your MailCraft contacts

key.name: accounts
key.description: Account ids. Empty means every account.
